explain.say: Here is a puzzle for you. A whale lives in the sea and swims like a fish. So is a whale a fish? Let's find the clues that tell animal groups apart, and you will be able to sort almost any animal.

explain.say: Look at the Mammals group. Mammals have hair or fur, and mothers feed their babies milk. A whale has a few hairs and feeds its calf milk, so it is a mammal! So is a bat, and so are you. Can you name a mammal in your home?

faq.q: What makes an animal a mammal?
faq.a: Mammals have hair or fur, breathe air with lungs, and the mothers feed their babies milk. Most give birth to live babies.
No. A whale is a mammal. It breathes air through a blowhole, has a little hair, and feeds its calf milk. Fish breathe with gills.
asks: Why is a whale not a fish?

faq.a: Yes. Penguins cannot fly, but they have feathers and a beak and lay eggs, so they are birds. Their wings work as flippers for swimming.

faq.q: What makes an animal a reptile?
faq.a: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin, breathe with lungs, and most lay eggs with tough shells on land. Their body warmth comes from their surroundings.
No. A bat is a mammal that can fly. It has fur instead of feathers, and mother bats feed their babies milk.
asks: Why is a bat a mammal?

facts: The platypus and echidnas are mammals that lay eggs.
Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly.

quiz.say: A dolphin lives in the sea, breathes air and feeds its baby milk. Which group is it in?
quiz.why: Breathing air and feeding babies milk are mammal clues, so a dolphin is a mammal.

wrong.0: Fish breathe with gills; dolphins come up to breathe air.
wrong.2: Reptiles have dry scales and do not feed babies milk.

quiz.say: Which clue proves an ostrich is a bird?
quiz.show: Which clue makes an ostrich a bird?
quiz.why: Only birds have feathers, so feathers prove it.

wrong.0: Lots of animals run fast, like cheetahs, which are mammals.
wrong.2: People have two legs too, and we are mammals.
